events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas. He died six days later on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty years ago today, we lost a true icon. Tupac Shakur's impact on music and culture is still felt profoundly, his tracks remain as powerful as ever.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Rock legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: The guitar god Jimi Hendrix left us on this day in 1970, but his revolutionary sound continues to inspire generations of musicians and fans.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That iconic zebra crossing, those timeless tracks – a masterpiece from start to finish.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the indomitable Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders' legendary voice and attitude still shine bright.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher turns 54 today. Still bringing that rock'n'roll swagger and unmistakable vocals to the stage.

events.title: The First iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago today, Apple launched the original iPod. Suddenly, thousands of songs in your pocket became a reality – remember click wheels?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to 007, the enduring icon of espionage, style, and incredible theme tunes.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to resonate globally.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedic icon John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us endless laughter.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles' iconic 'White Album' arrived. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that still sparks debate and delight.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Queen frontman and rock legend Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy continue to inspire and electrify.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles changed the game with 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that marked a new era for the Fab Four.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world mourned the tragic loss of John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, we tragically lost John Lennon. His powerful message of peace and love continues to resonate across generations.
